title: Cosmic Vortex Figures
description: A surreal psychedelic painting depicting four stylized green-skinned female figures with elaborate patterned headdresses floating within a swirling cosmic vortex. A bright glowing orb sits at the center of the spiraling tunnel of vibrant rainbow colors against a starry space background.
prompt: Psychedelic surreal cosmic scene featuring four stylized green-skinned women with intricate patterned afrofuturist headdresses floating around a glowing central orb inside a swirling rainbow vortex tunnel. The figures have elegant profiles and decorative hair, surrounded by stars, nebulae, and flowing colorful ribbons in a vibrant dreamlike space environment, highly detailed psychedelic art style.
